metadata.content:
*Pillars of ice erupt from the ground and launch your foes into the air.*

| **Psionic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged)** |                   **Main action** |
|---------------------|----------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) 10**    | **🎯 Three creatures or objects** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Intuition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/intuition):**

- **≤11:** Vertical [slide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 6
- **12-16:** Vertical [slide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 8
- **17+:** Vertical [slide](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 10

**Effect:** The pillars vanish as soon as the effects of the [forced movement](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) are resolved.
